title: 1 bedrm 1 mile to Grand Ole Opry
description:
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

The space
Steeped in Southern traditions of hospitality and charm, you’ll want for nothing as you adventure day and night in Music City. Luckily, this warm, friendly resort is close to Nashville’s best music, liquor, and historical landmarks.
Located just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry, 
 unit provides a great base to explore all the middle Tennessee has to offer. Conveniently located near popular destinations like the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum and the Nashville Zoo, you can easily explore all that Nashville has to offer. Plus, take a scenic drive out to the Jack Daniel’s Distillery or explore the shops and restaurants of Green Hills. Resort provides shuttle service to downtown!

Other things to note
please note renovations are in process and room decor can vary
